cohort: Two cohorts of women who gave birth in 2006 (n=366) and 2017 (n=342) in a hospital in Sweden
finding: Overall satisfaction with postnatal care increased from 2006 to 2017, with improvements in most areas of care, although some women still reported not receiving adequate information or help.
mod_finding: Women who had a caesarean section received less information and practical help compared to those who delivered vaginally.
